title: Complimenting a Nice Hand After Showdown
summaryJa: ショーダウン後、対戦相手の良いプレイを褒めるという、ポーカーテーブルでよく見られる友好的な交流です。このような自然な英語での会話は、ゲーム中に他のプレイヤーとの関係を築き、テーブルの雰囲気を良好に保つのに役立ちます。
segments: You: Nice hand, by the way. That was a tough spot.
Opponent: Thanks, I got lucky with the turn card.
You: Yeah, but your call was good. Not many people would take that line.
Opponent: I appreciate that. You played it well too—I almost folded.
You: No way! You had to see the river. Good luck the rest of the tournament.
